title: TotemShield
description: This plugin adds a system of lives. It allows for you to absorb totems and protects you from lethal damage.
body: This plugin allows you too absorb totems making it so you don't die. The effects are a bit stronger than ussual. You can absorb a max of 3 totems and the cooldown for use is 30 seconds. You can use /totem to check how much lives are you on and your current cooldown. This is my first plugin so if you spot any bugs or anything unintended you can report it. If you think something should be added you can also say it. Also this plugin wasn't tested for anything except paper 1.21.11 but it might work on other game versions and plugin engines.
